# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security issues privately to the project maintainers through the repository's configured private security reporting channel or security contact. Do not publish exploit details before maintainers have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate.

Include affected versions/components, reproduction steps using non-sensitive test data, expected vs actual behavior, and impact. Do not include production secrets, customer data, or unrelated personal information.

## Supported Versions

Document supported release lines here.

## Scope

Document which domains, repositories, APIs, mobile clients, and infrastructure are in scope for coordinated testing. Explicit authorization is required for active testing outside systems you own or are permitted to assess.
